scope: Signed-source publication preparation; no registry push or deployment

checks: Non-root Node 24 runtime excludes repository, tests, development state and build tools
Explicit initialization publishes a pinned identity using external secret custody
Ordinary API startup refuses an uninitialized volume
A second container cannot take ownership of the same live store
Keyless app container serves the session API through exact-origin scoped boundaries
Every packaged service-worker precache response matches its recorded bytes
SIGKILL/restart reacquires ownership and preserves identity plus the accepted registration attempt
Graceful stop exits cleanly; explicit initialization retry retains the existing identity

compatibility.basis: Diff against main: no account-protocol or core/schema/public-state changes; scoped HTTP uses the existing request/response shapes. Client changes reuse existing content/source/spool/delivery records.
compatibility.mixedBuildLimits: No exhaustive old/new-client cross-product campaign; normal cached-client update behavior remains. Reference-mode rollback at this source was tested against retained stores.
